zh-TW.title: SuperNova — 統一社交數據採集平台｜Pysdn SuperCool
zh-TW.description: SuperNova：企業級多平台社交數據採集系統，插件化適配器、三層存儲架構、動態功能開關與企業級容錯。
zh-TW.hero_sub: 統一介面 · 多平台採集 · 企業級容錯
zh-TW.intro_p: 通過統一的介面管理多個社交平台的數據採集任務，具備動態降級、精細調度、灰度發布和資源隔離能力。支援 B 站、抖音、微博、Instagram、Telegram 等平台。
zh-TW.f1: 插件化適配器：統一介面設計，輕鬆接入新平台（B 站/抖音/微博/Instagram/Telegram）
zh-TW.f2: 三層存儲架構：MongoDB（原始數據）+ PostgreSQL（標準化）+ Elasticsearch（檢索）
zh-TW.f3: 企業級容錯：熔斷器、差異化重試、帳號池管理、代理池評分
zh-TW.f4: 動態功能開關：四層控制（全域/平台/功能/策略），支援熱更新無需重啟
zh-TW.f5: 異步高併發：asyncio + uvloop + Celery 分散式任務佇列
zh-TW.arch_html: 用戶交互層（FastAPI REST API + React Web UI + CLI）→ 任務調度層（Celery + Redis）→ 平台適配層（插件化 Adapter）→ 數據處理層（清洗、標準化、去重）→ 持久化層（MongoDB + PostgreSQL + Elasticsearch）。
zh-TW.platforms_html:
• B 站：影片、評論、彈幕採集
  • 抖音：短影片、用戶資料、互動數據
  • 微博：貼文、轉發、評論、熱搜
  • Instagram：貼文、Stories、Reels
  • Telegram：頻道消息、群組動態
zh-TW.quickstart_html:
git clone https://github.com/iiooiioo888/SuperNova.git
cd SuperNova
pip install -e .
# 設定 .env
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
zh-TW.api_html:
• POST /api/tasks — 建立採集任務
  • GET /api/tasks/{id} — 查詢任務狀態
  • GET /api/data/{platform} — 獲取採集數據
  • POST /api/adapters — 註冊新適配器
  • GET /api/health — 健康檢查

en.title: SuperNova — Unified Social Data Collection Platform｜Pysdn SuperCool
en.description: SuperNova: Enterprise-grade multi-platform social data collection system with pluggable adapters, three-layer storage, dynamic feature flags, and enterprise fault tolerance.
en.hero_sub: Unified Interface · Multi-Platform Collection · Enterprise Fault Tolerance
en.intro_p: Manage data collection tasks across multiple social platforms through a unified interface, with dynamic degradation, fine-grained scheduling, canary releases, and resource isolation.
en.f1: Pluggable Adapters: Unified interface design for easy integration of new platforms (Bilibili/Douyin/Weibo/Instagram/Telegram)
en.f2: Three-Layer Storage: MongoDB (raw data) + PostgreSQL (normalized) + Elasticsearch (search)
en.f3: Enterprise Fault Tolerance: Circuit breakers, differentiated retries, account pool management, proxy pool scoring
en.f4: Dynamic Feature Flags: Four-level control (global/platform/feature/strategy), hot-reload without restart
en.f5: Async High Concurrency: asyncio + uvloop + Celery distributed task queue
en.arch_html: User Interaction Layer (FastAPI REST API + React Web UI + CLI) → Task Scheduling Layer (Celery + Redis) → Platform Adapter Layer (Pluggable Adapters) → Data Processing Layer (Cleaning, Normalization, Deduplication) → Persistence Layer (MongoDB + PostgreSQL + Elasticsearch).
en.platforms_html:
• Bilibili: Videos, comments, danmaku
  • Douyin: Short videos, user profiles, engagement data
  • Weibo: Posts, reposts, comments, trending
  • Instagram: Posts, Stories, Reels
  • Telegram: Channel messages, group activity
en.quickstart_html:
git clone https://github.com/iiooiioo888/SuperNova.git
cd SuperNova
pip install -e .
# Configure .env
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
en.api_html:
• POST /api/tasks — Create collection task
  • GET /api/tasks/{id} — Query task status
  • GET /api/data/{platform} — Fetch collected data
  • POST /api/adapters — Register new adapter
  • GET /api/health — Health check
